'''SV Ried''', commonly known as '''SV Oberbank Ried''' for sponsorship reasons, is an [[Football in Austria|Austrian association football]] club based in [[Ried im Innkreis]], Upper Austria. The team plays its home matches at [[Josko Arena]], a stadium with a capacity of 7,680. The team plays in the [[Austrian Football Bundesliga]], the top tier of the [[Austrian football league system]]."}}
